candidate_burden.scope_limit: Candidate volume measures reviewer workload only. A lower number is not evidence of better recall, safer edits, or better audio.

current_human_review.draft_rule: review_draft.json is never a final human decision record

feedback.reason: no complete real-human decision record exists for this run

observed_acceptance_rate.reason: no complete real-human decision record exists for this run

historical_feedback_regression.scope_limit: historical development regression only; it does not label current-run candidates, authorize edits, or form a frozen benchmark

limits: NOT_MEASURED means evidence is absent, incomplete, invalid, or outside this scorecard; it never means zero problems or pass.
Candidate burden is workload metadata, not a proxy for recall, semantic safety, or audio quality.
Historical Mentor feedback is development-only regression context and never becomes a current-run decision or automatic policy.
No-candidate windows require real human listening; an unlistened plan cannot support a missed-edit conclusion.
Transition QC is an objective priority ranking only. It does not hear naturalness, validate meaning, or authorize edits.

no_candidate_audit.reason: the plan exists, but not every sampled window has a recognized real-human outcome
no_candidate_audit.result_protocol: Every window must use NO_CLEAR_ISSUE, POSSIBLE_MISSED_EDIT, or CLEAR_MISSED_EDIT_NEEDS_NEW_CANDIDATE before the sample result is measured.

candidate_recall_against_human_edit_map.reason: no validated human edit map/reference EDL is part of this development scorecard

current_review_packet_completion.reason: review workflow status, not a quality verdict

net_time_saved.reason: real review, rework, maintenance, and baseline manual time have not been recorded together

no_candidate_region_missed_edit_signal.reason: no fully completed human no-candidate audit sample exists

rendered_transition_naturalness.reason: transition_qc ranks objective anomalies for re-listening; it never measures naturalness, semantic correctness, or an automatic pass

serious_semantic_misdeletion.reason: requires explicit human semantic/whole-episode evaluation; candidate count or acceptance rate cannot substitute

next_gates: 真实审核人完成当前 review package 的每一条 accept/reject；草稿不算决定。
真人同步试听所有固定无候选窗口，并以规定 finding 写入结果；发现问题先形成新候选。
正常 resume 后生成两份 transition_qc，再把其优先项纳入人耳复听。
单独记录整片语义/听感、返工与工时；本 scorecard 不产生发布或 Champion 晋升结论。
scorecard_status.reason: run is still at CALIBRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED; no human decision, EDL, render, or transition-QC result exists

transition_qc.reason: this run is pre-render, so transition QC is not generated yet

human_approved.reason: post-render transition QC has not been generated

machine_assisted_draft.reason: post-render transition QC has not been generated

subjective_naturalness.reason: transition_qc ranks objective anomalies for re-listening; it never measures naturalness, semantic correctness, or an automatic pass
